text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text, so they can find meaning in what people write or say. NLP is used in translation tools, which help us communicate across different languages. It also powers sentiment analysis, where computers discover whether a message is positive or negative. Another common example is chatbots, which answer questions and talk with customers online. Thanks to NLP, technology can interact with us in a more natural and useful way every day.
